about: Near conversations (ink UI round; design gen/life/design.md 'Close (≤ 2.5 m, facing)', lines from gen/life/vignettes_S4_S6.md). Walk within about 3 m of the host figure and face it; E (a seal on touch) plays the beats as speech (say) or thought (think) bubbles over each speaker's head, at most two open at once. roles: figure slugs of this section's people.json; name = the role in period terms (no invented personal names). Every beat cites its reading (src). Lines are proposals in Song vernacular, in 繁體; text only until a voice provider is chosen. Bundled by tools/ui_data.mjs into web/public/assets/ui/talk.json.

scenes.title: 鬧市說書
scenes.reading: 余辉 2023: a curly-bearded teller, 17-18 rapt listeners; the scroll's only public show. 名画记 39: 杂剧, 唱曲, 讲史, 小说. 《东京梦华录》卷五 京瓦伎艺: 讲史 and 小说 tellers, '霍四究，说《三分》'.

scenes.title: 正店門前賣花
scenes.reading: 余辉 2023: flower seedlings for sale at the 正店 door; an asker, a man with a child on his neck behind. 名画记 37: peddlers solicit at the door. The map makes the asker an old man in a tall hat. Chosen: 余辉's flower seller with the map's asker.
